correctness.rationale: The proof constructs a clique indexed by the minimal primes, proves it totally dominates, establishes an m-vertex lower bound for every total dominating set by maximal annihilating ideals, and then resolves paired domination exactly by parity. The odd-case extra vertex is shown to be genuinely new and explicitly matched.

evidence: Chelvam--Selvakumar gives paired domination only while explicitly assuming the ring is Artinian.
Nikandish--Maimani--Kiani gives domination and total domination for reduced rings with finitely many minimal primes.
Badie gives total-domination formulas in the reduced finite-minimal-spectrum setting.
The 2024 full text discusses domination and total domination and contains no paired-domination match.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The final claim combines the reduced finite-minimal-spectrum structural regime of the total-domination literature with a matching constraint previously proved only in the Artinian regime; none of the inspected broader sources states that extension.

originality.rationale: The 2014 paired-domination theorem is Artinian; the 2015 and 2021 reduced finite-minimal-spectrum results cover total domination, not paired domination. Targeted searches found no prior theorem extending the paired parity formula to all reduced rings with finite minimal spectrum.
residual_risks: An unindexed source may contain the same non-Artinian extension.
